title: game/data/lines/<id>.json: a Billie line (a species and its evolutions; species ids are <line id><stage>)

prof.description: the six stat weights (hp, then the others in stats.json order)

cry.description: SND-3: each stage's cry: a base (SND-6: a kind in music.json cries.bases, e.g. beast), a pitch (the first note, midi) and a length (1 as long as the cries made from the id); null, or a key left out, takes what the id makes

name.description: SND-6: a name for the cry. Claude's drafts start with "placeholder" (the Studio's Check lists them)

parts.description: phase 16: each stage's native parts (its fitting set), a kit part id (partKits.json parts) per slot of rules.json parts.slots; written by tools/build-kit-billies.py
